case.summary: On 2016-12-03 06:04:26, transaction 3509359 for $125.08 on card C12265-K2 was flagged due to a risk score of 0.52 associated with an unrecognized device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080). Initial actions included issuing step-up authentication, verifying the purchase with customer C12265, opening a case, and placing card C12265-K2 under monitoring. The cardholder successfully completed the one-time passcode challenge and confirmed making the purchase on a new device. Consequently, the transaction was allowed, the new device was added to the user's profile, and the alert was cleared as legitimate activity.
